beginner_intro: An-Nasr ("The Divine Support") is a Medinan surah of 3 ayahs. Arabic text: Tanzil Project (Uthmani script). Translation: Pickthall (public domain).

translations.text: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

ayahs.arabic_text: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا

translations.text: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,

ayahs.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

translations.text: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
